title: Weiliaozi (English)
summary: A complete English reading of the Weiliaozi, one of the Seven Military Classics: five scrolls and twenty-four chapters on regulation, discipline and military law, including the only body of Warring States army statutes transmitted as text. It is the only one of the seven with no usable punctuated edition online, so the punctuation here is supplied and checked by machine against the Siku quanshu text, and collated against the Tang anthology of 631 and a Shanghai Library woodblock edition.
